paragraphs: Minyamin, the Egyptian convert. R. Yehudah said: Minyamin the Egyptian convert was my colleague, one of R. Akiva's students, HaArel 76b; Sotah 9. Tosefta Kiddushin 5 has R. Akiva say to him, 'Binyamin, you erred.'
